EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretching bands at 2935/2985 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) and pronounced CH bending near 1454/1466 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003). A very intense band at 784 cm⁻¹ is consistent with a symmetric ring-breathing mode of an acetal/dioxolane-type ether ring, and strong features at 1108 and 1197 cm⁻¹ are characteristic of C–O–C stretches in cyclic ethers. The mid-band at 1651 cm⁻¹ fits an imine C=N stretch (in the 1620–1660 cm⁻¹ region), while the absence of an NH stretch (~3300–3400 cm⁻¹; GFQ-002) and lack of a distinct carbonyl C=O band near ~1700–1750 cm⁻¹ disfavor amide/lactam or aldehyde candidates. Candidate 1 (a bicyclic acetal bearing an imine) matches the observed ether-ring and C=N features best among the list.
